pages.title: The Nether
pages.text: **Incendium** rebuilds the Nether. It adds new biomes, mobs, structures and loot, so the Nether plays differently from vanilla.

**Biomes:** Infernal Dunes, Inverted Forest, Quartz Flats, Toxic Heap, Volcanic Deltas, Weeping Valley, Ash Barrens and Withered Forest.\
\
**Structures:** a Forbidden Castle, Infernal Altar, Nether Reactor, Piglin Village, Ruined Lab, Sanctum and Quartz Kitchen.

Castles, the Sanctum and the Nether Reactor are guarded by named mobs: knights, archers, pyros, cultists, apostles and more. Piglin villages have civilians and guards.\
\
There are also an Abandoned Tower and a Pipeline.

Structure chests and some mobs hold **artifacts**: unique named weapons and tools, such as the Ragnarok bow, Firestorm crossbow, Trailblazer and Voltaic Trident.\
\
The pack's no-Elytra datapack stops castle Paratroopers dropping wings. Incendium only reshapes newly generated Nether.

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Create's heat source. Loaded with a blaze from a Nether fortress spawner.

Other mods add to the Nether too. [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm](entry://exploration/cataclysm)[#]() has Nether bosses and arenas, and [#](2E5AAC)[Dungeons and Taverns](entry://exploration/structure_packs)[#]() adds Nether keeps, ports and skeleton towers.

The Nether is where Create's [#](2E5AAC)[heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() starts: Blaze Burners are loaded with blazes from fortresses. Its ores are listed in the [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#]().
